requirements.text: Rectangular base plate is 180 mm wide (X), 120 mm deep (Y) and 8 mm thick.
Base plate sits on the build plate with its bottom face at z=0.
Four 5 mm diameter through-holes are cut in the base plate for mounting screws.
Each mounting hole has a diameter of 5 mm.
Each mounting hole is located 12 mm in from the corner (12 mm from each of the two adjacent edges), one per corner.
Phone cradle backrest is 80 mm wide, 110 mm tall and 6 mm thick.
Backrest leans back 70 degrees from the base plane.
Phone cradle is located on the front-left of the base.
Front lip is 80 mm wide, 12 mm tall and 6 mm deep.
Front lip is located at the foot of the backrest to stop the phone sliding.
A charging cable slot passes through both the lip and the backrest.
Cable slot is 10 mm wide and 15 mm deep.
Tablet slot consists of two parallel upright walls on the base.
Each tablet wall is 70 mm wide and 60 mm tall.
Tablet slot walls are located on the right half of the base.
Inner faces of the tablet walls are 14 mm apart, giving 1 mm clearance each side of a 12 mm thick tablet.
Storage box is located at the back of the base.
Storage box is 160 mm wide, 40 mm deep and 30 mm tall.
Storage box is open-top.
Storage box outer walls are 3 mm thick.
Box interior is divided into four equal compartments by internal walls.
Internal divider walls are 2 mm thick.
Lid is a flat plate 160 mm wide, 40 mm deep and 4 mm thick.
Lid covers the storage box.
Lid rotates on two pin hinges along the box's back edge.
Pins pass through knuckles on both the box and the lid.
Hinge pins are 4 mm in diameter.
Hinge pin to knuckle clearance is 0.3 mm.
Lid must remain a separate solid from the box and base.
Lean angle is an adjustable parameter.
Tablet gap is an adjustable parameter.
Box height is an adjustable parameter.
Compartment count is an adjustable parameter.
No fillets or chamfers anywhere in the model.
No geometry extends below the base bottom (z<0).
